## What A&S Contracting Services Does

A&S Contracting Services is a licensed and insured general contractor based in Warrenton, Missouri. The company self-performs residential and light commercial construction services — roofing, siding, gutters, soffit, fascia, windows, doors, drywall, interior renovations, exterior work, and general contracting — within a 50-mile radius of Warrenton. As a licensed GC, A&S manages permits, inspections, scheduling, and full project execution under one contract.

## Services

### Roofing
Professional roofing installation, repair, and replacement for residential and commercial properties. Materials include asphalt shingles, architectural shingles, and metal roofing options. A&S handles storm damage documentation and insurance claim support.

### Siding
Installation and repair of vinyl, fiber cement, and engineered wood siding. Full exterior transformations including trim, window wrap, and corner detail work. Energy efficiency and curb appeal improvements for Warrenton-area homes.

### Gutters
Seamless gutter installation (5" and 6"), gutter repair, gutter guard installation, and downspout rerouting. Proper drainage to protect foundations and landscaping from water intrusion.

### Soffit
Aluminum and vinyl soffit installation and repair. Vented and solid panel configurations. Improves attic ventilation and eliminates wildlife entry points at the roofline.

### Fascia
Fascia replacement using aluminum-capped wood, solid aluminum, and composite materials. Protects roof edges and supports gutter systems. Often completed alongside soffit replacement.

### Windows & Doors
Window installation and replacement — double-hung, casement, sliding, bay, and specialty configurations. Entry door and patio door installation. Energy-efficient models with Low-E glass. Improves home comfort and reduces heating/cooling costs.

### Full-Scale Interior Work
Complete interior renovations including drywall, framing, insulation, flooring, painting, and finish carpentry. Can handle demo through final finish. Level 3, 4, and 5 drywall finish available. Manages full gut-and-rebuild on single rooms or entire homes.

### Exterior Work
Comprehensive exterior renovation packages combining siding, roofing, soffit, fascia, gutters, and window trim under one project scope. Eliminates trade coordination gaps that cause delays and cost overruns on multi-contractor projects.

### Drywall
Drywall installation, repair, and finishing at all levels. Level 5 finish for high-spec residential and commercial spaces. Texture matching for repairs. Water damage and mold remediation preparation.

### General Contracting
Full-service GC services for projects of any scope — planning, permitting, scheduling, execution, and final walkthrough. Single point of accountability for projects that span multiple trades.
